prompt_summary: Use the old close image only as the identity and pose reference. Redraw the entire Naeru from scratch as one cohesive polished illustration, including its body, face, arms, tongue, belly, feet, tail, winter hat and scarf. Give it a muted warm-cranberry slouchy knitted beanie with a narrow oatmeal ribbed cuff and cream pom-pom, plus an oatmeal scarf behind the tongue with a short cranberry-striped tip. Keep the friendly three-quarter pose, simple solid oval eyes without eyelids, delicate warm gray-brown contours and soft hand-painted animation-film shading. Use genuine transparent RGBA. No pasted accessories, tracing, coat, mittens, boots, snow, background, shadow or text.
